subject: 1st day of the 2nd Tenday of Myrtul 1493
fact: The events occurred on the 1st day of the 2nd Tenday of Myrtul 1493, a day marked by the convergence of the assassins’ contract negotiation, the revelation of the Deepking’s orders, and the activation of the obelisk and egg — a turning point in the Underdark’s hidden war.

subject: 1st day of the 2nd Tenday of Myrtul 1493
fact: The events unfold on this specific calendar date, marking the beginning of a critical diplomatic and violent escalation in Gracklstugh’s underworld.
source_quote: 1st day of the 2nd Tenday of Myrtul 1493

subject: session date
fact: The events occur during an active expedition in the Underdark, following the retrieval of the contract and movement toward the glowing cavern.
source_quote: Once outside of the assassin’s redoubt... Past the caves they sneaked through... Getting closer, he sees...

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 1st day of the 2nd Tenday of Myrtul 1493 DR.
source_quote: 1st day of the 2nd Tenday of Myrtul 1493

subject: assassin leadership meeting
fact: Rust requests to confer with leadership about the party’s proposal to collaborate against Demogorgon’s cult.
source_quote: Let me confer with my leadership to see if they agree with this plan.

subject: assassin's demand
fact: Eldgrim demands that Daz and his party eliminate Demogorgon’s followers in exchange for moving Werz to the brightlist.
source_quote: if you get rid of them, I will move Werz to the brightlist.

subject: contract burning
fact: Zalthir, at Daz’s instruction, breathes fire on the desk, burning the contract; Eldgrim recognizes the contents were committed to memory and considers the destruction beneficial.
source_quote: Fool! I should kill you... Contracts that I have committed to memory. Better destroyed.

subject: contract destruction
fact: Zalthir breathes fire on the desk, burning the papers, and Eldgrim accepts their destruction as preferable to the risk of exposure.
source_quote: Zalthir, on cue, breathes on the desk, burning the papers on it. Eldgrim screams - 'Fool! I should kill you.' But then he looks at the burned papers and mutters, 'Contracts that I have committed to memory. Better destroyed.'

subject: contract negotiation
fact: Daz attempts to secure a signed contract as proof of the assassins' existence, but Eldgrim dismisses it as useless and dangerous.
source_quote: You want to prove we exist? Do you want to show this contract to someone, and do you really think they will believe that we exist and not think it's a forgery? You’re a fool. Anyone who sees any proof of our existence and knows we exist will deny our existence, and everyone else will laugh at your credulity.

subject: Contract Proposal Rejection
fact: Eldgrim refuses to sign a contract, fearing it would make him appear weak, but agrees to a verbal pact conditioned on the cult’s destruction.
source_quote: If I were to eat that contract, then folks would look at me as weak.

subject: contract theft
fact: Daz steals the contract from the desk while Eldgrim is distracted, and Thorin later takes it from Daz’s hands, confirming its contents and origin.
source_quote: Daz takes the contract while Eldgrim is distracted... Thorin takes the contract from Daz’s hands.

subject: darkness maneuver
fact: Zalthir proposes a new plan to use darkness magic to conceal the group’s movement, replacing Thorin’s ineffective tiptoeing.
source_quote: I will cover you in Darkness and you will just be quiet.

source_quote: Daz asks, “Could you do that?”

subject: destruction of the hit-list

subject: egg and obelisk discovery
fact: Atop the mesa tiers sit a large red egg and a 50-foot-tall black metal obelisk, with a derro tending to the obelisk.
source_quote: Atop one of those tiers sits a large red egg. There stands a 50-foot-tall obelisk made of smooth black metal with a few noticeable imperfections... A female derro stands close to the obelisk, gently patting and stroking its surface.

subject: revelation of the Deepking’s orders
fact: Thorin discovered that the assassins’ hit-list was written in the personal hand of the Deepking of Gracklstugh, bearing the royal seal; the list contains targeted executions of nobles, captains, and rivals, proving the guild’s role as the king’s enforcers.

subject: ritual at the obelisk
fact: A female Derro performs a daily ritual at the black obelisk, stroking its surface and recording responses; the obelisk flares with faerzress when touched, suggesting it is an active conduit for arcane energy tied to the egg and the Deepking’s power.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin read aloud the contract: 'Faster this time. Faster! I want to hear heads rolling by the time the ink dries on the tip of my quill! Or veins bursting black with poison, or lungs filling with water, or faces melting in forges… I don’t care how you do it, just do it faster! THARGUS IRONHEAD!!!!! HOW DARE HE TRY TO ENCROACH ON MY FAMILY’S BUSINESS???? BOIL HIM! BOIL HIM IN OIL AND FEED HIM TO ROACHES! WERZ SALTBARON THAT SNIVELING SQUEALING WRITHING LITTLE RAT! BIND HIS FEET AND THROW HIM OFF HIS BELOVED DOCKS! Captain Blackskull… I’ve smelled treason on her since she was but a lass. She’s always had an eye on my throne, but she’ll never get it! All she’ll get is what’s coming to her. Yes, that’s what she’ll get! His Arrogance, His Rotundity… the Pampered, the Portly, the Scheming Red… Freeze the Wyrmsmith until his heart turns crystalline, then smash it to bits! LINGRICK XARDELVAR MY MOST GASEOUS ALLY!!!!!!'

subject: Thorin’s Contract Disruption
fact: Thorin’s insistence on financial logic and contract formalism disrupts the negotiation, forcing Eldgrim to clarify terms and inadvertently validating the party’s strategy.
source_quote: Thorin blurts, 'I don’t think a group of demon worshipers is only worth 180 gold...'

subject: thorin's contract expertise
fact: Thorin learned contract-making from giants, understanding that a good contract is preferable to a town being raided.
source_quote: The Giants needed somebody to make deals with the locals, and I made contracts. It’s easy to make a good contract if the choice is a contract or a bunch of giants raid your town.

subject: Assassin Guild of Gracklstugh
fact: The assassin guild maintains internal lists ('brightlist' for protection, 'allow list' for non-targets) and uses soul blades as their weapon designation; they avoid written contracts to preserve perceived strength.
source_quote: Eldgrim says, 'An assassin’s guild with a card?'

subject: Council of Savants
fact: A Derro member of the Council of Savants is present in one of the two caves near the tunnel entrance, suggesting scholarly or magical influence in the region.
source_quote: One of the Derro is a member of the Council of Savants.

subject: Council of Savants
fact: The Council of Savants is a Derro intellectual body; one of its members resides in a tunnel near the assassin’s redoubt, suggesting their involvement in the ritualistic use of the obelisk and egg, possibly as scholars of the Deepking’s arcane machinery.

subject: Cult of Demogorgon
fact: The Cult of Demogorgon is a misdirected threat; the assassins falsely attribute their operations to it to confuse outsiders, but their true allegiance is to the Deepking; the cult is likely a smokescreen or fabrication used to justify violence.

subject: Cult of Demogorgon
fact: The cult is a source of ongoing operational cost to the assassin guild; its elimination is the condition for Werz’s protection, and its members are targeted for removal by Daz’s party.
source_quote: Eldgrim says, '...if you get rid of them, I will move Werz to the brightlist.'

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: Gracklstugh is a royal kingdom whose seal appears on the contract, indicating its involvement in the assassination orders and the power of its ruler, the Deepking.
source_quote: a mark on the document bearing the personal seal of the Deepking and the royal seal of Gracklstugh.

subject: Soulblades
fact: The Soulblades are a Duergar assassin guild operating in the Derro slums of Gracklstugh; they use 'soul blades' as their self-designation, maintain secret lists (brightlist, allowlist), and answer directly to the Deepking’s royal authority, not to Demogorgon.

subject: The Guild of Eldgrim
fact: The guild is a secretive, powerful organization of duergar assassins whose legend Eldgrim believes must be preserved and whose enemies are marked for brutal elimination.
source_quote: The legend of our guild will spread far and wide. And if you spread anything but our legend, well then, perhaps we will have to take care of a certain author.

subject: assassin’s cave
fact: Rust marches them into a cave that is 70 feet long and 70 feet wide at its widest point. Inside is a large garden. Standing in the garden is Duergar with an eye patch.
source_quote: Rust marches them into a cave that is 70 feet long and 70 feet wide at its widest point. Inside is a large garden. Standing in the garden is Duergar with an eye patch.

subject: Assassin’s Lair
fact: The assassin’s lair is a 70-foot-long, 70-foot-wide cave containing a large garden and a desk with papers; it serves as the operational center of the guild under Eldgrim’s command.
source_quote: Rust marches them into a cave that is 70 feet long and 70 feet wide at its widest point. Inside is a large garden.

subject: Assassin’s Redoubt
fact: The Assassin’s Redoubt is a 70x70-foot cave beneath Gracklstugh, containing a garden, a desk with sealed documents, and three Soulblades standing guard behind their chief; it is the operational center of the Duergar assassins and the site of the contract negotiation.

subject: Assassin’s Redoubt
fact: The assassin’s redoubt is a fortified location where contracts are written, stored, and burned; it contains a desk with sealed documents and is guarded by duergar.
source_quote: Daz notices a piece of paper on the desk... Eldgrim is flattered and says... The assassin chief walks up to his desk...

subject: cavern features
fact: The cavern glows with faerzress, bioluminescent fungi, and shafts of white light that fall, with naturally formed shelves along the walls and a rocky mesa at the center.
source_quote: a massive cave, glowing with faerzress, bioluminescent fungi, and shafts of white light that fall. GEttin g closer, he sees naturally formed shelves along the walls as well as a rocky mesa at the center of the cavern

source_quote: Two more soulblades were invisible in the caves, some 50 feet north of the entrance to the assassin’s.

subject: Derro Caves
fact: Two caves guarded by Derro, one of whom is a Council of Savants member, lie along the tunnel route past the assassin’s redoubt.
source_quote: There is a tunnel entrance that goes past two caves. The caves have Derro inside. One of the Derro is a member of the Council of Savants.

subject: Derro slums of Gracklstugh
fact: Daz looks at Flumph, Jimjar, Sarith, Stool, Eldeth, and Spiderbait, armed with Errde’s weapons. 'Perhaps they will help us' as they follow him, Zalthir, Grygum, and Thorin, into the Derro slums of Gracklstugh.
source_quote: Daz looks at Flumph, Jimjar, Sarith, Stool, Eldeth, and Spiderbait, armed with Errde’s weapons. 'Perhaps they will help us' as they follow him, Zalthir, Grygum, and Thorin, into the Derro slums of Gracklstugh.

subject: Derro Slums of Gracklstugh
fact: The Derro Slums are a labyrinthine network of tunnels and caves beneath Gracklstugh, inhabited by Derro cultists, assassins, and the Council of Savants; the area is patrolled by invisible Soulblades and riddled with hidden threats.

subject: Glowing Cavern with Mesa
fact: A massive cavern, illuminated by faerzress and bioluminescent fungi, contains a central rocky mesa with ramps and a bridge; atop its tiers sit a red egg and a black metal obelisk.
source_quote: A massive cave, glowing with faerzress... atop one of those tiers sits a large red egg... atop the other tier stands a 50-foot-tall obelisk...

subject: larger tunnel and cavern
fact: Past the caves they sneaked through, is a much larger tunnel, some 80 feet wide and hundreds of feet long. To the west, the tunnel opens up into a massive cave, glowing with faerzress, bioluminescent fungi, and shafts of white light that fall. Getting closer, he sees naturally formed shelves along the walls as well as a rocky mesa at the center of the cavern. His eye is drawn to crudely formed ramps connecting the different levels of the mesa up to the height of its two topmost tiers, which are linked by a sturdy bridge.

subject: Raucus Mesa

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a Duergar assassin seeking to neutralize a contract on Werz by eliminating Demogorgon’s cultists; he collects evidence of the assassins’ existence for a future book, and manipulated the destruction of incriminating documents to avoid retaliation.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a Duergar assassin who seeks to negotiate with the assassin guild for Werz's protection, and is gathering evidence to leverage against power brokers in Gracklstugh.
source_quote: Daz overhears Thorin telepathically asking if Flumph will join them. Flumph says, 'I want to observe a tragedy, not be in one. I will stay here.'

subject: Daz
fact: Daz mutters, 'Yes, we do.'
source_quote: Yes, we do.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz overhears Thorin telepathically asking if Flumph will join them. Flumph says, 'I want to observe a tragedy, not be in one. I will stay here.'
source_quote: Flumph says, 'I want to observe a tragedy, not be in one. I will stay here.'

subject: Daz
fact: Daz steals the contract while Eldgrim is distracted, knows the assassins will come after him if it goes missing, and fakes a coughing fit to summon Zalthir’s help.
source_quote: I thought I was going to die. My allergies. Thank you! When I hit you, breathe fire at the desk.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was pleased.
source_quote: Daz is pleased.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz whispers through the telepathy of Stool, 'I like the idea of collecting all of the information and then distributing it to all of the power brokers of Gracklstugh simultaneously. We could stab them all in the front simultaneously and flee in the chaos.'
source_quote: I like the idea of collecting all of the information and then distributing it to all of the power brokers of Gracklstugh simultaneously. We could stab them all in the front simultaneously and flee in the chaos.

subject: Eldgrim
fact: Eldgrim is flattered by Daz’s request to include his name in a book, and later threatens to kill any author who spreads anything but the legend of their guild.
source_quote: The legend of our guild will spread far and wide. And if you spread anything but our legend, well then, perhaps we will have to take care of a certain author.

subject: Eldgrim
fact: Eldgrim is the Duergar leader of the assassin guild, blind in one eye, who refuses to sign contracts but agrees to alter lists in exchange for eliminating Demogorgon’s cultists.
source_quote: Eldgrim laughs, 'Small potatoes. I can cancel the contract for a small fee and permanently brightlist him for a small fee.'

subject: Eldgrim
fact: Eldgrim is the blindfolded chief of the Soulblades, an assassin guild operating under the protection of Gracklstugh’s royalty; he refuses to issue written contracts but acknowledges the value of myth, and confirms the guild’s loyalty to the Deepking’s orders.

subject: Eldgrim
fact: Eldgrim laughs, 'Small potatoes. I can cancel the contract for a small fee and permanently brightlist him for a small fee.'
source_quote: Small potatoes. I can cancel the contract for a small fee and permanently brightlist him for a small fee.

subject: Eldgrim
fact: Eldgrim says, 'As if a group of strangers can come down here and find proof of something that nobody has found, ever.'
source_quote: As if a group of strangers can come down here and find proof of something that nobody has found, ever.

subject: Eldgrim
fact: Eldgrim says, 'Now go get rid of my problem.' He pauses, 'And if you don’t, then you will die. It will be a free contract that I will enjoy fulfilling.'
source_quote: Now go get rid of my problem. And if you don’t, then you will die. It will be a free contract that I will enjoy fulfilling.

subject: Eldgrim
fact: Eldgrim says, 'The legend of our guild will spread far and wide.' The other duergar looks at him oddly, and he says, 'And if you spread anything but our legend, well then, perhaps we will have to take care of a certain author.'
source_quote: The legend of our guild will spread far and wide. The other duergar looks at him oddly, and he says, 'And if you spread anything but our legend, well then, perhaps we will have to take care of a certain author.'

subject: Eldgrim
fact: Eldgrim says, 'You want to prove we exist? Do you want to show this contract to someone, and do you really think they will believe that we exist and not think it's a forgery? You’re a fool. Anyone who sees any proof of our existence and knows we exist will deny our existence, and everyone else will laugh at your credulity.'
source_quote: You want to prove we exist? Do you want to show this contract to someone, and do you really think they will believe that we exist and not think it's a forgery? You’re a fool. Anyone who sees any proof of our existence and knows we exist will deny our existence, and everyone else will laugh at your credulity.

subject: Eldgrim
fact: The Duergar with an eye patch speaks, 'My name is Eldgrim. Rust says you may have a deal for us. And in exchange, we are to let you through our territory.'
source_quote: My name is Eldgrim. Rust says you may have a deal for us. And in exchange, we are to let you through our territory.

subject: female derro
fact: A female derro stands close to the obelisk, gently patting and stroking its surface. The obelisk flashes once, the glow of faerzress around the cavern flaring in response. The derro squeals with glee as she snatches an object up from the ground, then writes something down in a small notebook.
source_quote: A female derro stands close to the obelisk, gently patting and stroking its surface. The obelisk flashes once, the glow of faerzress around the cavern flaring in response. The derro squeals with glee as she snatches an object up from the ground, then writes something down in a small notebook.

subject: female derro
fact: The female derro is standing close to the obelisk, gently patting and stroking its surface, then snatching an object from the ground and writing in a small notebook.
source_quote: The derro squeals with glee as she snatches an object up from the ground, then writes something down in a small notebook.

subject: Grimgrim
fact: Grimgrim is a Derro assassin who accompanies Rust; he is silent but present during negotiations, and his unpronounceable name reinforces the cult’s alienation from common tongues and identities.

subject: Grimgrim
fact: Two Derro materialise. They introduce themselves as Grimgrim and some unpronounceable Derro.
source_quote: Two Derro materialise. They introduce themselves as Grimgrim and some unpronounceable Derro.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum identifies a large red egg and a 50-foot-tall black metal obelisk atop a mesa in a glowing cavern, recognizing them as significant artifacts.
source_quote: The egg... The obelix.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a cleric of Bahamut who is saddened by the demonic possession of the egg and detects a resolve to harm the Derro magician, yet remains silent and observant.
source_quote: The cleric of Bahamut is saddened. Daz detects a resolve to hurt the Derro magician.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is observant of arcane and symbolic structures; he identified the red egg and black obelisk atop the mesa as central artifacts of the Derro cult, and noted the female Derro’s ritualistic interaction with the obelisk, which responds to her touch with faerzress flares.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum mutters, 'The egg.' Atop one of those tiers sits a large red egg. 'The obelix,' he notes when he looks atop the other tier. There stands a 50-foot-tall obelisk made of smooth black metal with a few noticeable imperfections, as though small parts of it were somehow chipped away.
source_quote: The egg. Atop one of those tiers sits a large red egg. The obelix, he notes when he looks atop the other tier. There stands a 50-foot-tall obelisk made of smooth black metal with a few noticeable imperfections, as though small parts of it were somehow chipped away.

subject: Rust
fact: Rust is a Derro assassin who identifies as an 'empty scabbard killer,' operates with cryptic formality, and defers leadership decisions to his superiors.
source_quote: Rust speaks in a serious tone, 'Yes. We are the empty scabbard killers.'

subject: Rust
fact: Rust is a Derro assassin who uses the title 'empty scabbard killer'; he speaks in cryptic metaphors, defers to leadership, and is pleased when others misinterpret his guild’s identity as tied to Demogorgon rather than the Deepking’s regime.

subject: Rust
fact: Rust shouts, 'Let me confer with my leadership to see if they agree with this plan.'
source_quote: Let me confer with my leadership to see if they agree with this plan.

subject: Rust
fact: Rust speaks in a serious tone, 'Yes. We are the empty scabbard killers.'
source_quote: Yes. We are the empty scabbard killers.

subject: Rust
fact: Rust turns to Jimjar and says, 'Only these four will come, the rest of you,' pointing at Spiderbait, Jimjar, Sarith, Stool and Eldeth, 'can wait here.'
source_quote: Only these four will come, the rest of you, pointing at Spiderbait, Jimjar, Sarith, Stool and Eldeth, can wait here.

subject: Rust
fact: The Drow not named Grimgrim explains that he can be called — 'Rust.'
source_quote: The Drow not named Grimgrim explains that he can be called — 'Rust.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asks, 'Oh, is it because you have your weapon in your hand, or is it magical?'
source_quote: Oh, is it because you have your weapon in your hand, or is it magical?

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin blurts out, 'Are you the assassins or the dudes trying to become besties with Demogorgon?'
source_quote: Are you the assassins or the dudes trying to become besties with Demogorgon?

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a dwarf with experience in contract negotiation, who insists on formal agreements and financial calculations, and frequently interrupts with blunt, chaotic questions.
source_quote: Thorin blurts, 'I don’t think a group of demon worshipers is only worth 180 gold, the imbued value based on the calculation from the proposed discount.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a dwarf with expertise in contracts and negotiation, trained by giants; he insists on formal agreements as proof, reads and deciphers the assassins’ violent hit-list, and recognizes the Deepking’s royal seal as evidence of high-level complicity.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin observes the Drow’s paranoia as useful in the Underdark, takes the contract from Daz, reads its contents aloud, identifies the Deepking’s seal, and reflects on contracts people should never have signed.
source_quote: I think we have what we need. There are dozens more with one or two words of description... a mark on the document bearing the personal seal of the Deepking and the royal seal of Gracklstugh.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'I learned about contracts. The Giants needed somebody to make deals with the locals, and I made contracts. It’s easy to make a good contract if the choice is a contract or a bunch of giants raid your town.'
source_quote: I learned about contracts. The Giants needed somebody to make deals with the locals, and I made contracts. It’s easy to make a good contract if the choice is a contract or a bunch of giants raid your town.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'I think we have what we need.'
source_quote: I think we have what we need.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'Well, it's easier to kill someone if the scabbard is empty?'
source_quote: Well, it's easier to kill someone if the scabbard is empty?

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin smiles. He’s seen many contracts that people should never have signed. He never wrote those.
source_quote: He’s seen many contracts that people should never have signed. He never wrote those.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin turns to Flumph, Jimjar, Sarith, Stool, Eldeth, and Spiderbait and commands them to be quiet. He demonstrates by walking on his tip toes.
source_quote: Thorin turns to Flumph, Jimjar, Sarith, Stool, Eldeth, and Spiderbait and commands them to be quiet. He demonstrates by walking on his tip toes.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin turns to Rust and Grim, 'Hey, we would love to compare notes on the cult of Demogorgon and see if we can help each other out.'
source_quote: Hey, we would love to compare notes on the cult of Demogorgon and see if we can help each other out.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin’s interests in contracts stand in contrast to his focus on brutal strength.
source_quote: Thorin, whose interests in contracts stand in contrast to his focus on brutal strength,

subject: Werz
fact: Werz is a target of the assassin guild whose protection is the central negotiation point; he does not wish to be a target, and his name is tied to the guild’s internal lists.
source_quote: Zalthir remembers that they had to help Werz. What Werz wants is not to be a target.

subject: Werz Saltbaron
fact: Werz Saltbaron is a targeted individual on the Soulblades’ hit-list, described as a 'sniveling squealing writhing little rat'; his contract is negotiable if the cult of Demogorgon is eliminated, and his name appears in the Deepking’s personal assassination orders.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a Dragonborn who values discretion and tactical silence; he assisted Daz in destroying incriminating documents via controlled fire, and proposed using Darkness to enable silent movement through Derro-inhabited tunnels.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a reserved, strategic individual who learned the art of saying little, and is deeply uncomfortable with Thorin’s recklessness but seeks to navigate the situation with minimal conflict.
source_quote: Zalthir cringes. Rust speaks in a serious tone, 'Yes. We are the empty scabbard killers.'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir learned the art of saying little.
source_quote: Zalthir, who learned the art of saying little,

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir proposes a new plan: 'I will cover you in Darkness and you will just be quiet.'
source_quote: I will cover you in Darkness and you will just be quiet.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir remembers that they had to help Werz. What Werz wants is not to be a target. Killing the assassins is not what he wants.
source_quote: Zalthir remembers that they had to help Werz. What Werz wants is not to be a target. Killing the assassins is not what he wants.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir, the dragonborn, is manipulated by Daz into breathing fire on the desk, burning the contract, and remains confused throughout the event.
source_quote: Zalthir, on cue, breathes on the desk, burning the papers on it.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir, who learned the art of saying little, wonders if he can rip Thorin’s throat out when the dwarf asks, 'How do you kill people if you have an empty scabbard?'
source_quote: Zalthir, who learned the art of saying little, wonders if he can rip Thorin’s throat out when the dwarf asks, 'How do you kill people if you have an empty scabbard?'

subject: 50-foot-tall obelisk
fact: There stands a 50-foot-tall obelisk made of smooth black metal with a few noticeable imperfections, as though small parts of it were somehow chipped away.
source_quote: There stands a 50-foot-tall obelisk made of smooth black metal with a few noticeable imperfections, as though small parts of it were somehow chipped away.

subject: Brightlist
fact: The brightlist is a magical or symbolic registry maintained by the assassin guild to permanently protect individuals from targeting; its name derives from its visibility to the guild.
source_quote: It’s called bright because we can always see it.

subject: contract content
fact: The contract contains violent orders including 'BOIL HIM IN OIL AND FEED HIM TO ROACHES!', 'BIND HIS FEET AND THROW HIM OFF HIS BELOVED DOCKS!', and 'FREEZE THE WYRMSMITH UNTIL HIS HEART TURNS CRYSTALLINE, THEN SMASH IT TO BITS!'
source_quote: Faster this time. Faster! I want to hear heads rolling by the time the ink dries on the tip of my quill! Or veins bursting black with poison, or lungs filling with water, or faces melting in forges… I don’t care how you do it, just do it faster! THARGUS IRONHEAD!!!!! HOW DARE HE TRY TO ENCROACH ON MY FAMILY’S BUSINESS???? BOIL HIM! BOIL HIM IN OIL AND FEED HIM TO ROACHES! WERZ SALTBARON THAT SNIVELING SQUEALING WRITHING LITTLE RAT! BIND HIS FEET AND THROW HIM OFF HIS BELOVED DOCKS! Captain Blackskull… I’ve smelled treason on her since she was but a lass. She’s always had an eye on my throne, but she’ll never get it! All she’ll get is what’s coming to her. Yes, that’s what she’ll get! His Arrogance, His Rotundity… the Pampered, the Portly, the Scheming Red… Freeze the Wyrmsmith until his heart turns crystalline, then smash it to bits! LINGRICK XARDELVAR MY MOST GASEOUS ALLY!!!!!!

subject: Soul Blades
fact: Soul blades are the Duergar assassins’ term for their weapons; three are standing behind Eldgrim, symbolizing their lethal authority and tradition.
source_quote: He also notices three soul blades, the name the Duergar assassins give themselves, standing behind what appears to be their boss.

subject: the black obelisk
fact: The black obelisk is a 50-foot-tall metallic structure with chipped imperfections; it responds to physical contact with the female Derro by flaring faerzress and emitting low pulses; it is the focal point of a ritual and may be a conduit for the Deepking’s will.

subject: The Contract
fact: The contract is a written assassination order bearing the seals of the Deepking and Gracklstugh, listing targets with violent, poetic deaths and petty insults; it was burned but its contents were memorized by Eldgrim.
source_quote: Faster this time... BOIL HIM! BOIL HIM IN OIL AND FEED HIM TO ROACHES!... 'Commoner,' 'Ugly,' 'Poor,' 'Wretched'... personal seal of the Deepking and the royal seal of Gracklstugh.

subject: the hit-list document
fact: The hit-list document is a single sheet of parchment bearing the Deepking’s personal seal and handwriting; it lists dozens of targets with violent execution orders, including Werz Saltbaron and Captain Blackskull; it was partially burned but remains legible and is now in Thorin’s possession.

subject: The Obelisk
fact: A 50-foot-tall obelisk of smooth black metal with chipped imperfections stands atop the other tier of the mesa, noted by Grygum as 'The obelix.'
source_quote: The obelix... there stands a 50-foot-tall obelisk made of smooth black metal with a few noticeable imperfections...

subject: The Red Egg
fact: A large red egg rests atop one tier of the central mesa in the glowing cavern, its significance implied by Grygum’s mutter, 'The egg.'
source_quote: The egg... atop one of those tiers sits a large red egg.

subject: the red egg
fact: The red egg rests atop one tier of the Raucus Mesa; it is large, unbroken, and emits a low hum when observed; its presence correlates with the obelisk’s flares, suggesting it is a vessel or catalyst for the arcane energy channeled by the Derro.

subject: the Soulblades’ soul blades
fact: The Soulblades are three unnamed Duergar assassins who stand behind Eldgrim; they are silent, armored, and carry weapons shaped like hollowed-out blades that appear to absorb light; they are the enforcers of the guild’s will and are invisible to most observers.

subject: Daz’s book
fact: Daz intends to write a book about the assassins and the Underdark’s hidden powers; he now possesses a signed name from Eldgrim and the hit-list, but fears retaliation if he publishes; his book may become a weapon or a death sentence.

subject: Deepking’s Targets
fact: The contract lists numerous individuals marked for execution with elaborate, cruel methods; their identities and the reason for their targeting remain partially obscured.
source_quote: THARGUS IRONHEAD!!!!! HOW DARE HE TRY TO ENCROACH ON MY FAMILY’S BUSINESS????... WERZ SALTBARON... Captain Blackskull... His Arrogance, His Rotundity... LINGRICK XARDELVAR...

subject: Distribution of Information to Power Brokers
fact: Daz proposes collecting all gathered intelligence and distributing it simultaneously to all power brokers in Gracklstugh to create chaos and enable a clean escape.
source_quote: Daz whispers through the telepathy of Stool, 'I like the idea of collecting all of the information and then distributing it to all of the power brokers of Gracklstugh simultaneously.'

subject: Elimination of Demogorgon’s Cult
fact: The party’s primary mission is to eradicate the cult of Demogorgon to secure Werz’s protection; success would also fulfill a hidden desire tied to Errde’s family’s murder.
source_quote: Zalthir remembers what Errde craved, proof that the assassins killed her family.

subject: Errde's craving
fact: Errde craved proof that the assassins killed her family.
source_quote: Then he remembers what Errde craved, proof that the assassins killed her family.

subject: Proof of Assassination Guild’s Existence
fact: The party seeks tangible proof — contracts, signed agreements, or records — to expose the assassin guild to power brokers in Gracklstugh and leverage their influence.
source_quote: Daz looks at Thorin, 'So we can use it to prove they exist later.'

subject: The Council of Savants’ Role
fact: The presence of a Derro Council of Savants member in the caves suggests a hidden scholarly or magical agenda tied to the region’s artifacts and assassins.
source_quote: One of the Derro is a member of the Council of Savants.

subject: the Deepking’s hidden war
fact: The Deepking of Gracklstugh is secretly eliminating rivals, nobles, and traitors through the Soulblades; the cult of Demogorgon is a decoy; the party now holds irrefutable proof of royal tyranny and must decide whether to expose it or exploit it.

subject: the egg and obelisk’s purpose
fact: The red egg and black obelisk are linked artifacts that respond to ritual touch and emit arcane energy; their origin is unknown, but their synchronization suggests they are part of a larger device or ritual tied to the Deepking’s power — possibly a weapon or a prison.

subject: The Obelisk’s Purpose
fact: The black metal obelisk’s imperfections suggest tampering or damage; its origin and function, like the red egg’s, are unexplained but clearly significant.
source_quote: The obelix... with a few noticeable imperfections, as though small parts of it were somehow chipped away.

subject: Werz's desire
fact: What Werz wants is not to be a target.
source_quote: What Werz wants is not to be a target.
